images.caption: Figure 1:Given a single input image and a camera trajectory, PPMem autoregressively generates video while accumulating a persistent plane-based 3D memory.We show two DL3DV scenes (indoor, outdoor) with generated frames at selected indices. Insets visualize the plane pool at each frame, colored by the current view frustum. The plane geometry grows to cover the full explored scene, serving as persistent spatial memory for subsequent generation.

Figure 2:PPMem architecture overview.The Wan DiT receives noisy video latents channel-concatenated with projected source-view RGB/masks and partial depth rendered from the plane pool; context frames are prepended temporally. The DiT produces two token streams:video tokensdecoded by the Wan VAE into RGB outputs, andgeometry tokensadapted by geometry LoRA and fused with partial depth tokens via a ViT-based Depth Token Fusion module. The fused tokens are decoded into per-frame plane primitives, which merge into the persistent plane pool. The pool is rendered at the next chunk’s target cameras and fed back as conditioning.

Figure 4:Qualitative long-context comparison.PPMem preserves scene structure and color consistency across the full sequence. VMem collapses early under large viewpoint change; SPMem grows vague and drifts; Gen3C and Voyager lose structural alignment as the viewpoint diverges.

Figure S1:Accumulated plane pool vs. Plana3R reconstruction.We render depth from our plane pool and from planes reconstructed by
Plana3R[18]on the same generated video. The pool built online
during generation stays consistent, whereas pairwise reconstructions conflict
across views and fragment.

Figure S2:Failure case: fine text rendering under zoom-in.Scene structure and prominently visible text are preserved across 288 frames, but text that is barely legible in the initial viewpoint becomes garbled as the camera approaches. Faithful text synthesis from low-resolution observations remains an open challenge for video diffusion models.
Figure S3:Additional qualitative comparison: outdoor rooftop scene.PPMem maintains structural consistency across 288 frames under large viewpoint change.
